device.basis: Control group window. Base-parameter words sit at +0x00 and +0x08, the request descriptors at +0x40, the completion word at +0xf0 and the request word at +0x80; X-T3 5.11 polls the request word, whose low three bits clear once the request completes. The 8-tick acknowledge is a declared stand-in, and the descriptor and parameter words read back their last write until their layouts are recorded.
